Stat Blocks.title: Animated Conquester
languages: understands the languages of its creator but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Armored Hull
traits.description: The vessel adds its Constitution modifier to its armor class.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vessel makes two Missile Salvo attacks.

actions.name: Missile Salvo
actions.description: Macro Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 300/900 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 2) fire damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage (macro: 32 fire plus 24 force).

actions.name: Chase Fire
actions.description: The vessel makes one Missile Salvo attack and takes the Dash action.

actions.name: Ram (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The vessel moves up to half its movement speed, moving through creatures in its path and pushing any Huge or smaller creature to the nearest unoccupied space outside its movement path. If it is on path to collide with a creature that is Gargantuan or larger, it stops moving before entering their space. Each creature pushed or collided with must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (6d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save. If a creature stops the vessel’s movement and fails they take 71 (10d12 + 6) instead.

options.name: Missile Spawn
options.description: The vessel makes one Missile Salvo attack against one target within range.

options.name: Countermeasures
options.description: The next time a creature attacks the vessel before the start of its next turn, the vessel rolls a Missile Salvo attack. If the result of the Missile Salvo attack is higher than the vessel’s armor class, it may treat the result of the Missile Salvo attack as its armor class instead until the end of that turn.

options.name: Acceleration (Costs 3 Actions)
options.description: The vessel moves up to its movement speed or, if it’s available, may take the Ram action.
